results.text: A Rare Case of Pulmonary Edema Secondary to Hydrochlorothiazide Use. Noncardiogenic pulmonary edema has been reported as a rare adverse reaction of hydrochlorothiazide. Symptoms can develop acutely after medication ingestion, and patients may present acutely ill. The mechanism by which hydrochlorothiazide causes pulmonary edema remains unknown and is considered idiosyncratic.
